speaker: mary_shakespeare
text: It is good you came at Lent and not only wrote it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I said Friday in a letter, and then I came.

speaker: mary_shakespeare
text: I have said the one thing. I will not say it twice.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: The children are ahead. Thy arm again, Will. The lane does the rest.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: That is enough porch. Dinner is pottage, and I will not have it made into a sermon.

speaker: mary_shakespeare
text: I am not making one. I have finished.
